The ontology's threshold names both the 1939 and the 1940 German-Soviet agreements; v1's accept_pact sets secured in 1939Q3 (the pact of 23 Aug 1939), while the hindsight snapshots read dependent until the Commercial Agreement of 11 Feb 1940 (the record's delivery date), so the snapshot convention (docs/ambiguous_levels.md section 3) puts the model's clock in the set. The secured member rests on v1's own clock (the realized accept_pact of 1939Q3) and on the record's later deliveries (the Commercial Agreement of 11 Feb 1940); it does NOT rest on the German-Soviet credit agreement of 19 Aug 1939, which the owner ruled out as a source (decision 5c; the snapshot change dating secured from it was withdrawn, docs/crisis_1939_decisions.md C12, docs/guard_changelog_ww2.md row of 2026-10-23), although accept_pact's own source= names it among the pact's documents. The replay proposals of 1939Q3 resting on the credit agreement (1939Q3-061, -068, -099) and the 1939Q4 delivery reports (frus1939v01/d504, d513, d515), whose agreement the documents do not distinguish from the credit agreement, are not used as member indicators. Accepted as proposed (owner's decision 7j; candidate 3 of docs/ambiguous_levels.md section 8).
